summary: This memo proposes a standard for message encapsulation, meaning forwarding one or more messages inside another. It also defines "bursting," which unpacks forwarded messages so they can be distributed, forwarded, or replied to.

eli5.summary: Putting a letter inside a new envelope is easy, but the person you sent it to needs a way to open the outer envelope and use the letter inside.
